independenceRule: Mastery aggregates valid competency evidence across distinct opportunities and attempts. It never reads XP, coins, rank, Marzi stage, time spent, hang-up, reward claims, or scenario visit count.

states.meaning: Too little valid evidence to make a claim.
Some demonstrated evidence exists, but it is limited, inconsistent, or highly supported.
Repeated evidence exists with material gaps or support dependence.
Repeated, sufficiently independent, current evidence meets the approved rubric across relevant contexts.
Previously supported capability should be checked again because evidence is old, recently weak, or context-limited.

confidenceDimensions.meaning: How many distinct valid opportunities produced evidence.
How many distinct attempts produced evidence.
How consistent the observations were with each other.
How many scenarios, groups, and level bands the evidence spans.
The distribution of OFF, HINT, and FULL assistance across the evidence.
How current the evidence is under the approved recency policy.
Whether the evaluator and rubric version are still valid for the claim.
Evidence that points against the state.

thresholds.note: Numeric minimums, recency windows, and aggregation weights are deliberately absent. No default is invented. Release-mode validation fails while this gate is open.

es.label: Todavía sin datos suficientes
es.explanation: Aún no hemos visto lo suficiente para decir nada sobre esta habilidad.

en.label: Not enough evidence yet
en.explanation: We have not seen enough yet to say anything about this skill.

it.label: Ancora pochi elementi
it.explanation: Non abbiamo ancora visto abbastanza per dire qualcosa su questa abilità.

tr.label: Henüz yeterli veri yok
tr.explanation: Bu beceri hakkında bir şey söyleyecek kadarını henüz görmedik.

ar.label: لا توجد أدلة كافية بعد
ar.explanation: لم نرَ بعد ما يكفي لنقول شيئًا عن هذه المهارة.

uk.label: Поки замало свідчень
uk.explanation: Ми ще не побачили достатньо, щоб сказати щось про цю навичку.

es.label: Empezando
es.explanation: Ya lo has hecho alguna vez, pero todavía con poca práctica o con mucha ayuda.

en.label: Starting out
en.explanation: You have done this before, but so far only a little or with a lot of help.

it.label: Agli inizi
it.explanation: L'hai già fatto, ma finora poche volte o con molto aiuto.

tr.label: Yeni başlıyor
tr.explanation: Bunu daha önce yaptın ama şimdilik az ya da çok yardımla.

ar.label: في البداية
ar.explanation: قمت بذلك من قبل، لكن حتى الآن قليلًا أو بمساعدة كبيرة.

uk.label: Початок
uk.explanation: Ти вже це робив, але поки що небагато або з великою підтримкою.

es.label: En progreso
es.explanation: Ya lo haces varias veces, aunque todavía con algunos huecos o apoyándote en la ayuda.

en.label: Coming along
en.explanation: You do this repeatedly now, though there are still gaps or some reliance on help.

it.label: In sviluppo
it.explanation: Ormai lo fai più volte, ma restano alcune lacune o un po' di dipendenza dall'aiuto.

tr.label: Gelişiyor
tr.explanation: Artık bunu birden fazla kez yapıyorsun ama hâlâ boşluklar ya da yardıma bağlılık var.

ar.label: قيد التطور
ar.explanation: أصبحت تفعل ذلك مرارًا، لكن ما زالت هناك فجوات أو اعتماد على المساعدة.

uk.label: Розвивається
uk.explanation: Ти вже робиш це неодноразово, але лишаються прогалини або опора на підказки.

es.label: Consolidado
es.explanation: Lo haces de forma constante, por tu cuenta y en distintas situaciones.

en.label: Solid
en.explanation: You do this consistently, on your own, and across different situations.

it.label: Consolidato
it.explanation: Lo fai in modo costante, da solo e in situazioni diverse.

tr.label: Sağlam
tr.explanation: Bunu tutarlı biçimde, kendi başına ve farklı durumlarda yapıyorsun.

ar.label: راسخ
ar.explanation: تفعل ذلك بثبات، وبمفردك، وفي مواقف مختلفة.

uk.label: Впевнено
uk.explanation: Ти робиш це стабільно, самостійно і в різних ситуаціях.

es.label: Toca repasar
es.explanation: Hace tiempo que no lo practicas o solo lo has hecho en una situación. Merece la pena repasarlo.

en.label: Worth reviewing
en.explanation: You have not practised this for a while, or only in one situation. It is worth going over again.

it.label: Da ripassare
it.explanation: Non lo pratichi da un po', o solo in una situazione. Vale la pena rivederlo.

tr.label: Tekrar zamanı
tr.explanation: Bir süredir bunu çalışmadın ya da yalnızca tek bir durumda yaptın. Tekrar etmeye değer.

ar.label: يستحق المراجعة
ar.explanation: لم تتدرب على هذا منذ فترة، أو فعلته في موقف واحد فقط. من المفيد مراجعته.

uk.label: Варто повторити
uk.explanation: Ти давно цього не практикував або робив це лише в одній ситуації. Варто повторити.
